ICU transfer and procedure note, 2036-08-29

Intubated at 22:05 for respiratory failure, uncomplicated, grade 1 view. Propofol infusion started at 22:10 for ventilator synchrony.
Vent: AC/VC, TV 420, RR 22, PEEP 10, FiO2 70%.
Plan: lung-protective ventilation, continue dexamethasone, vasopressors if needed, daily sedation interuption when oxygenation allows.
